subject.title: fix(auto-reply): self-heal reply-session-init conflict instead of permanently wedging the session

question: Should maintainers accept this revalidated, fenced reply-session self-heal as the canonical recovery contract once the exact head is green?
rationale: Source and live evidence support the fix, but automation cannot decide whether forcibly interrupting competing work and resetting all registered harness bindings is the intended permanent behavior for persistent conflicts on this hot session path.

options.title: Accept Fenced Recovery
options.body: Resolve the exact-head check failures, then land the bounded recovery with its revalidation and admission-drain guards intact.

options.title: Require Broader Live Proof
options.body: Ask for one additional busy Telegram or Signal run proving concurrent message delivery remains correct before accepting the lifecycle contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Fenced Recovery
recommendation.body: Resolve the exact-head check failures, then land the bounded recovery with its revalidation and admission-drain guards intact.
